_about: Alopecia research watchlist v1 (S262, 2026-09-23). Sources the team keeps feeding into its knowledge, built from alopecia/research/EP290-CLAIM-LEDGER.md s7 and LABS-REGISTER.md. NOT WIRED YET: Phase C teaches the collector to read this file. Every entry was run against its live source on the date in 'validated'. Researcher and company names here are public work, not patients (plan s9). Outbound queries built from this file must still pass the privacy guard described in alopecia/research/TEAM.md s5: verbatim entries only, and a run-time refusal of any term from the on-box profile.

_kinds.pubmed: E-utilities esearch on 'query'; new PMIDs go through the normal dual screen
_kinds.ct_study: one ClinicalTrials.gov study; alert on status change or results posted
_kinds.ct_sponsor: all studies of one sponsor; alert on a NEW study
_kinds.ct_silence: completed AA trials with no posted results >12 months after completion: the 'look for the no' signal (METHODS.md s1 row 7)
_kinds.reporter: NIH RePORTER text search, FY current+previous; monthly
_kinds.youtube: channel RSS feed; only titles matching title_filter are fetched; NEEDS a new 'alopecia' lane in yt_watch (its existing lanes extract infrastructure ideas, not medical claims)
_kinds.press_page: company press-release page; manual or scraped monthly
_kinds.patent_manual: no free patent API wired; manual monthly check
